scoreQualification: Comparative observations against original and fixed target; no universal numerical pass threshold. Motion clipping is the concrete blocker.
observations: The new native collector is a substantial modeling improvement: a rounded thick cyan shell with genuine recessed interior, voluminous guarded mouth, rounded protective gold shoe, bearing/side construction and an actual finished rear seat. It replaces the source’s largely featureless cyan block with useful depth and construction.

Soft broad gradients separate cyan enamel, gray structural metal, dark intentional recess and warm protective base across all four facings. Light/gray/dark views are coherent without horizontal preferred highlights, white blank plates, directional ground shadows, unexplained black dead spots or halos.

The one-second mouth-pulse and guard-rock gesture is visibly stronger and distinguishable from idle in all four logical/phone facings, including N. Actual12fps playback and all12phases at32 and47.3px/cell were inspected. The inward half-cycle nevertheless breaks the upper guard’s visible continuity through the housing rim.

Native Sframes7–11 show the silver upper crossbar interrupted by the dark mouth surround, with parts appearing above the rim and shafts below it; frame9 side/W view also cuts the cage into the cyan shell. Independent native surface intersections confirm actual self-clipping rather than only normal depth occlusion.

The actual native assembled neutral is properly seated at the frozen uniform mount. Source55degree and main65degree projections differ as expected; exact canonical neutral resources remain identical. Other equipment and the main body are clearly provisional context.

Every declared packet render and preview content was inspected. All nine animated WebPs have12frames totaling1000ms; all decoded frames match their corresponding native published logical phases or actual consumer screenshots exactly. Repeated preview contains eight visible copies, and no unseen3x3 inspection is claimed.

A simple finished rear structural tongue remains visible in standalone views because it supplies the required native seat. It is purposeful contact construction, not a substitute blank cyan plate.
Small fasteners recede at32px/cell while the cyan rim, dark intake and gold base remain readable. Main body/other gear and final main576rendered clips remain pending.
